rules.rule: Long-form videos must maintain semantic scene diversity
Fallback/default scenes are forbidden in production
Grid children use parent-relative layout; do not reuse global absolute coordinates inside repeated cells
Production System v2+ requires a reviewed preproduction-plan.json before implementation/render
One existing template must not dominate a single video
rules.condition: each existing template <= 20% of all planned scenes

rules.rule: Do not repeat the same registered template three scenes in a row
Every scene is classified Existing, New or One-off; reusable New scenes are proposed for registry promotion before render
rules.condition: all scenes classified and reusable New scenes have proposedTemplateId

rules.rule: Each production should actively look for new reusable visual grammar without forcing one-off scenes into templates
rules.condition: target 2-5 reusable New template candidates; outside range is warning

rules.rule: Human spreadsheet ledger and GitHub runtime registries must match stable_id/version before a new production starts
Every beat must have measured VOICEVOX start/end timing
rules.condition: sync-timing beats count equals script beats count

rules.rule: Shared pronunciation dictionary is applied immediately before VOICEVOX synthesis
Pronunciation substitutions are logged as an artifact
Registered shared templates and pronunciation rules must not be copied back into per-video implementations
rules.condition: video manifest declares shared production system version

rules.rule: Video records rule registry versions used for production
rules.condition: manifest versions match current shared registries/policies

rules.rule: QA contact sheet is required before release
